name: tomb of annihilation
types: dungeon
triggered: trapped entry — each player loses 1 life.
triggered: veils of fear — each player loses 2 life unless they discard a card.
triggered: oubliette — discard a card and sacrifice an artifact, a creature, and a land.
triggered: sandfall cell — each player loses 2 life unless they sacrifice an artifact, a creature, or a land.
triggered: cradle of the death god — create the atropal, a legendary 4/4 black god horror creature token with deathtouch.
